title: nan
authors: Roggi G.; Meraglia S.; Lovera M.
key_contribution: Presents the Politecnico di Milano autonomous multicopter solution for an indoor urban-like GNSS-denied drone competition, including navigation, autonomous decision-making, planning, and experimental results.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
